barrier_equality: basket >= H is knocked out; alive uses strict < H
continuous_sampling: Independent common/idiosyncratic standard normals give exact GBM log increments at each contractual date before numerical representation.

digital_source.exponential: ln(2) range reduction and degree-12 Taylor polynomial evaluated by Estrin
digital_source.guard_semantics: Each accumulated log spot is clipped before its Estrin exponential; the digital guard's continuous-price bias remains unproved.
digital_source.integer_semantics: Signed two-complement fixed-point; flags and indexes are unscaled integers; all output arithmetic is modulo 2^width.
digital_source.law: Independent uniform 32-bit integers, paired Box-Muller with existing log/cos polynomial tables and integer square root
digital_source.output_dollar_conversion: Interpret output Y as signed two's-complement integer divided by 2^40; discount is already applied.

model: correlated geometric Brownian motion at contractual dates

notional_semantics.interpretation: One unit of the equal-weight basket/Asian call. Initial basket is $100; payoff is already in dollars. No extra factor of 100 or 0.01 is introduced.
notional_semantics.recovered_from: barrier_oracle_depth.build constants, 1/assets and 1/(assets*dates) averages, strike and discount; matches Stage A original_target and optimized target

output_contract.complete_advantage: T_Q <= fastest eligible complete measured T_C / 10
output_contract.final_strict_target_scope: 0.001 is the historical B4/B8 knock-out final test, not silently extended to every source family
output_contract.statistical_share_reference: e=0.45*epsilon retained as a historical/planning allocation, not an implemented estimator

payoff: exp(-r*T) * max(mean over all asset/date spots - K, 0) * indicator(max over monitored dates of equal-weight spot basket < H)
